offering_description.value: Develops application development tools, secure file transfer and document collaboration software, and data management software for enterprises, software vendors, and government agencies. It also provides infrastructure automation, network management, and web content management software through customer-managed deployments and cloud subscriptions.

primary_products.value: Application development platforms and UI components; secure file transfer and document collaboration software; databases and enterprise search software; infrastructure automation and network management software; web content management software

primary_services.value: Implementation consulting; migration and integration services; technical training

customer_segment.value: B2B: Enterprise application developers, IT teams, independent software vendors, and professional services firms; B2G: Government agencies with application development, data management, and secure file exchange needs

end_markets.value: Enterprise IT; software development; financial and professional services; healthcare; government

revenue_model.value: subscription: Cloud applications and term-based access to customer-managed software; licensing or royalties: Perpetual licenses and software licenses for independent software vendors; service fees: Implementation consulting, migration, integration, and training
revenue_model.category: subscription; licensing or royalties; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Develops and operates software for enterprise IT teams, application developers, and software vendors; service provider: Implements and integrates software into customers’ existing systems and trains their teams

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Application development, secure file exchange and collaboration, data management, IT operations, and web content management

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise account teams selling to IT and procurement departments; partners / resellers: Software vendors, value-added resellers, and systems integrators; online: Company web stores and self-service subscriptions

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Cloud services handling customer data are subject to privacy rules such as GDPR and the CCPA.
